I'm grateful that I was able to overcome it.

[D19:9] Tim: When things get tough, it's so important to remember why we love what we do. For me, it's writing and reading. That's what helps me stay motivated and push myself to get better. Has anything similar happened with basketball for you? Tell me about it!

Instead of getting stuck in that moment, I worked hard to get better. It taught me that resilience is key and owning up to mistakes is important. Gotta keep growing and striving to be a strong player and teammate. So grateful.
